findings.body: A filename stored in a constant still makes the consuming test disappear from selection. For example, `NAME = 'guide.md'; GUIDE = Path(__file__).parents[1] / 'docs' / NAME` followed by `GUIDE.read_text()` reads `docs/guide.md`, but `components(NAME)` returns an empty list because only file-rooted assignments enter `roots`. The computed suffix is therefore just `docs`, which cannot match the changed document. The docs classifier's remaining literal checks also cannot resolve the separately quoted directory and basename, so CI skips the tests; the pytest selector likewise selects nothing. Preserve literal-valued path variables and cover this case through the existing command-level regression test. The copied implementation in `.forge/review-tests.py` has the same defect.
